source: Alpe d'Huez Grand Domaine piste map (skimap.org map 41798, the resort's two-page PDF, slope map on page 2; the 2025-26 version, skimap 44282, has the same runs but faded raster lines): run labels are real text and the runs are vector lines in their colour; the nearest coloured run line to each label was found by script and every disagreement with OpenStreetMap was read by eye from enlarged crops
names_note: Map labels drop the article (gua = Le Gua, olmet = L'Olmet, rhodos = Les Rhodos, Ch. des demoiselles = Chemin des Demoiselles, Bd. des marmottes = Boulevard des Marmottes, bergerie = Bergeries, chavanus = Chavannus). Read differently from OpenStreetMap: Petit Prince red (OSM blue), Poutran blue (OSM red: the label sits on the blue line below Poutran 2), La Fuma blue (OSM ski route).

confirm.Stade: racing stadium beside the Stade lift above Alpe d'Huez, drawn hatched red as a reserved area
confirm.Altiport: label green near Bergers; OpenStreetMap has two pieces of this name with different ratings, so the rating is left as OpenStreetMap has it
confirm.Cristalliere: label between the blue and red lines under the Herpie chair; OpenStreetMap's blue kept

lifts_source: lift names printed in capitals on the same map (moving carpets and small drag lifts are not all printed)
